_design_notes: Experimental runs on top of the DuckDB 2.0 OpenIVM pin. Do not substitute these for Figure 1 per-model dbt timings.
The pipeline mode refreshes all existing materialized views once in dependency order; dbt's first model absorbs the pipeline time, so use OpenIVM profile and total dbt invocation time.
The watches diagnostic archives exact executed SQL and EXPLAINs its MERGE after refresh. Post-refresh delta cardinalities may differ from those at execution time.
